concerns.text: T006 states "Wilcoxon signed-rank only as convergence-failure fallback (never triggered by Shapiro-Wilk)", directly contradicting FR-006 which mandates the fallback be "triggered only if Shapiro-Wilk p < 0.05". The plan justifies the deviation, but the spec was never amended, so T006 as written violates FR-006. Amend FR-006 (or record the deviation) before the task list can claim FR-006 coverage.

FR-001 requires recruiting participants and FR-002 requires administering tasks "via a web interface"; no task builds either capability. The scope note authorizes simulation-only validation, but spec.md was never amended to record this narrowing — a silent retroactive narrowing of two MUST-level FRs. Amend the spec to stage/replace FR-001/FR-002's web-interface clause.

FR-009 requires a "pre-study pilot check (n=5)" verifying RTs and scoring against the reference implementation before recruitment. T002/T003 validate scoring only on synthetic data; the n=5 pilot portion of the requirement silently disappeared. Either amend FR-009 to a synthetic pilot or add a task covering it.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002/T003 vs constitution:Principle VI and spec.md:FR-002
concerns.text: Constitution VI: "Raw response data for these instruments MUST be preserved to allow re-scoring verification", and FR-002 requires recording response times and accuracy. The dataset schema (single `value` per metric) and T003's simulated CSV cannot represent trial-level RT/accuracy, so T002's 100–5000 ms RT filter and the <50% accuracy check have no data structure to operate on. No task produces or preserves raw trial-level data.

No task creates the pinned `requirements.txt` mandated by the constitution ("pins every Python dependency"), and no task checksums files under `data/` or records them in the state artifact_hashes map ("Every file under `data/` is checksummed"). Both are constitution MUSTs with zero task coverage.

The one-group design cannot support the causal attribution SC-001–SC-004 assert. T008/T010 add sensitivity analysis and limitation notes, but the success criteria in spec.md were never reworded; the tasks document should note that the spec amendment (or explicit rewording of SC-001–004 as pre/post association criteria) is required, otherwise T010's "success-criteria evaluation against SC-001–SC-005" evaluates criteria the design cannot satisfy.

The verifier-rejected deliverable expected `data/raw/synthetic_baseline.csv` from `synthetic_baseline.py`; T003 renames to `simulate_study.py`/`simulated_measurements.csv` with only an implicit mapping in the revision note. Make the filename mapping explicit to avoid re-rejection.
